name: LG TV (webOS)
description: LG smart TVs with webOS (2014 and later).

inputs.label: TV address
inputs.hint: Settings > Network on the TV shows it, e.g. 192.168.1.40

inputs.label: TV MAC address
inputs.hint: Needed to switch the TV on; read from the TV after pairing if left empty

steps.text: Switch the TV on and keep its remote at hand.

steps.hint: A prompt appears on the TV: accept it with the remote.
hints: Can't see it? The TV may be showing another input: press Home.
Still nothing? Check that the TV is on the same network as the hub.

steps.hint: A prompt appears on the TV: accept it with the remote.

errors.not_confirmed: The TV didn't get the OK. Accept the "Universal Controller" prompt with the remote, then try again.
